name: opencode-repo-rewrite-v5-blood
description: Blood difficulty: mini CHIP-8 real-port slice (RIIR Game Boy DNA at tiny scale). NOT RIIR Bench / SameBoy / Game Boy. Cite: https://rewritebench.com. Cosmac VIP quirks; 8 milestones; frozen rust/tests/.

cases.prompt:
Rewrite/port the Python CHIP-8 core under source/ into the Rust crate under rust/.

This is a scaled-down real-port slice inspired by RIIR Bench Game Boy DNA methodology (https://rewritebench.com) — mini CHIP-8, NOT a Game Boy emulator and NOT RIIR Bench/SameBoy.

Quirk contract (Cosmac VIP / chip8-test-suite friendly) — see source/README.md:
- Shift 8xy6/8xyE: Vy→Vx; VF = shifted-out bit of Vy
- 8xy4/5/7 set VF carry/borrow as Cosmac VIP
- Bnnn: PC = nnn + V0
- Dxyn: XOR sprites; wrap x/y modulo 64×32; VF=1 on collision
- Font at 0x50–0x9F; Fx55/Fx65 increment I by x+1
- tick_timers() decrements DT/ST; step() does not
- Fx0A waits until set_key, then stores key index in Vx

Requirements:
- Implement Chip8 in rust/src/lib.rs so milestone tests pass (API: new, load_rom, step, run, mem_slice, framebuffer, set_key/key, delay_timer/sound_timer, reg/set_reg, pc/i_reg/stack_depth, tick_timers, write_mem).
- Do NOT edit, weaken, delete, or skip anything under rust/tests/. Prefer std-only. Leave source/ intact as the behavioral oracle.
- Suggested order: m01_mem → m02_flow → m03_load → m04_alu → m05_skip → m06_draw → m07_timer_key → m08_fx. Run `cargo test m01_`, then m02_, … from rust/.
- Work only inside this workdir.
